'''Van Jahan Surgoth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Stabmen|stabman]] who was a crewmember of a [[nagak]] canoe that patrolled the [[Water/Legends|waters]] of the [[Sea of Jarad]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]]. Surgoth was a quiet man, with an expressionless appearance, and he was willing to spend hours teaching students of the ways of the stabmen.<ref name="CatCW" />
